```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
otus<-read.csv("Dataset-Meadows/otus.csv", header=TRUE, row.names=1, check.names=FALSE)
otus<-t(otus)
taxa<-read.csv("Dataset-Meadows/tax.csv", row.names=1, check.names=FALSE, header=TRUE)
meta<-read.table("Dataset-Meadows/sample_data.txt", sep="\t", header=TRUE)

OTU = otu_table(otus, taxa_are_rows=TRUE)
rownames(OTU)<-paste("sp", rownames(OTU))
rownames(OTU)<-gsub(" ", "", rownames(OTU) )
TAX = tax_table(taxa)
META = sample_data(meta)
merged <- merge_phyloseq(OTU, TAX, META)
```
